title: Priv SSO: hyphenated group mapping failure combined with KMS envelope rotation race (urgent patch)
creator: Marcus Lee
description: Summary: Multiple enterprise Private customers reported login failures and missing RBAC grants after a scheduled KMS envelope rotation and consequent SSO token refresh window. Investigation shows a twofold issue: (1) SAML group attribute normalization code dropped groups containing hyphens when the raw assertion used the dash-delimited format (e.g., 'team-engops'), and (2) a race during KMS envelope rotation caused ephemeral credentials to be reissued with stale role binding references, resulting in dropped audit events for affected sessions. Impact: customers experienced inability to access dedicated/private resources for short windows (30s-2m) and partial missing entries in audit logs for those sessions. Reproduction steps: 1) Configure private cluster with SAML group attributes containing hyphens. 2) Trigger KMS envelope rotation on the control plane during active SSO token refresh. 3) Observe user receives 403 on privileged routes and audit events missing for the failed token refresh window. Root cause: the SAML parser's attribute normalization pipeline used a regular expression that treated hyphenated group names as token separators; when combined with the token re-issuance path triggered during envelope rotation, role binding lookup used the pre-rotation cache key and dropped on miss rather than falling back, resulting in denied authorization and no audit entry. Temporary mitigations applied: 1) Turned on conservative SSO token fallback for impacted customers (config toggle) to accept both normalized and raw group claims. 2) Disabled automated KMS envelope rotation for affected clusters until patch is deployed. These mitigations were communicated to affected customers. Permanent fix plan: 1) Patch SAML attribute normalization to preserve hyphenated group tokens and add comprehensive unit tests (PR: infra#4286). 2) Change role-binding lookup to perform a tolerant lookup that attempts cache miss fallback to authoritative control-plane store and to emit audit entries before returning failures. 3) Harden KMS rotation path so reissued ephemeral credentials are atomically swapped with consistent cache invalidation (introduce a rotation epoch token). Rollout plan: - Patch to be deployed as hotfix to private control plane: rollout in canary (1 region) → staged rollout to remaining regions over 2 hours. - Monitor SSO error rate, authorization 2xx rate, and audit event completeness via dashboard. QA and validation: synthetic SAML assertions with hyphenated groups will be tested against canary clusters during patch window; stress test KMS rotation while simulating concurrent logins. Monitoring: target alert thresholds configured: SSO 5xx spike >50% baseline, RBAC 403 rate >3% of auth attempts for 10m. Rollback plan: if canary shows regression, revert control-plane binary and re-enable previous KMS rotation guard; customers will be notified. Postmortem and follow-ups: will include an exec summary, timeline, and action items (audit log backfill for missing entries where possible). Owner: Sofia Nguyen (ENG); PM liaison: Priya Singh. Estimated ETA for hotfix in prod: within 24 hours of ticket creation.
